Foundations

Typography

One grotesk does the work. Instrument Sans carries the wordmark, headings, interface and amounts; Geist Mono carries identifiers and tokens. Instrument Serif is the editorial voice — at most one line per marketing surface, and never inside the product.

AB · 3 · Groceries
text-2xs — avatar initials, the count on the bell, a category pill. The floor. Nothing that has to be read as a sentence goes here.

Seven steps, and only these seven. The scale had drifted to fourteen — 13px written both as text-[13px] and text-[0.8125rem], a half-point tier of 0.65625rem through 0.90625rem underneath it — which is how two labels showing the same kind of thing ended up a point apart on the same card. An arbitrary text-[…] in product code is a bug; the display numerals on the balance heroes are the one exception, and they are one-offs by design. src/components/ui/type-scale.test.ts fails the build on any other, so this paragraph is now checked rather than trusted.

Every step is one point larger below md. The scale reads well at a desk and cramped in the hand, and the hand is where nearly all of this app is used — so globals.css redefines --text-* under (width < 48rem): 2xs 11→12, xs 12→13, sm 14→15, base 16→17, lg 18→19, xl 20→21, 2xl 24→25. Gaps and ratios are unchanged. Because Tailwind compiles text-sm to font-size: var(--text-sm), redefining the token moves every call site at once — which is also why these must never be declared in an @theme inline block, where the value is substituted and the lever disappears.

Numerals

Tabular lining figures are enabled globally on html, and .tabular-nums restates it on amount columns. Digits must align down a list or the eye can't scan it.

Amounts arrive from Server Components as decimal strings of minor units and are formatted through Intl.NumberFormat. Never a JavaScript number, never a hand-written currency symbol — the separator, symbol position, and decimal count are all locale decisions.

Rules

Do

Use weight and colour to build hierarchy. Two weights (500, 600) and two text colours cover almost every screen.

Don't

Add a size between the steps above, set body copy below 14px, or bring the serif inside the product. The phone is the primary target.
